description: Voids a Wallet pass on the phone: "This pass was revoked and no longer works." Its code stops working at once; event_pass_reissue brings it back. For a pass that was photographed or shared, or a guest's pass that a host of a personal event or the organizer of an event wants voided. Nothing is re-added: the same pass updates in place on an iPhone and on Android. Needs `eventIdOrName` (the event id or the event name). Without `serialNumber` it acts on the caller's own pass at that event; with one it acts on that pass, for a caller who is a host or the organizer. Returns the outcome in one sentence.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event NAME as the organizer or the hosts spell it.

serialNumber.description: OPTIONAL. The pass serial (on the pass, ps_ and 24 characters). Omit for the caller's own pass.

name: event_pass_revoke
title: Revoke a Wallet pass
